plain_english: 'I', 'mine', 'this' and such — from coming to conviction: in supportless mind it goes — from that meditation's impulse, calm.
sanskrit_cite: ahaṃ mamedam ityādi pratipattiprasaṅgataḥ | nirādhāre mano yāti taddhyānapreraṇāc chamī

plain_english: Eternal, all-pervading, supportless, pervasive, and lord of all: words moment by moment meditated — aim done according to meaning.
sanskrit_cite: nityo vibhur nirādhāro vyāpakaś cākhilādhipaḥ | śabdān pratikṣaṇaṃ dhyāyan kṛtārtho 'rthānurūpataḥ

plain_english: Non-reality, Indra-net-shine — this all standing: what reality of the Indra-net? Thus from firmness, calm may go.
sanskrit_cite: atattvam indrajālābham idaṃ sarvam avasthitam | kiṃ tattvam indrajālasya iti dārḍhyāc chamaṃ vrajet

plain_english: Of self, unwavering — where knowing, where action? Knowing-dependent outer states: hence void, this world.
sanskrit_cite: ātmano nirvikārasya kva jñānaṃ kva ca vā kriyā | jñānāyattā bahirbhāvā ataḥ śūnyam idaṃ jagat

plain_english: Not of me bondage, not freedom — of the frightened, these terrors: this reflection of the intellect in waters, like the sun's.
sanskrit_cite: na me bandho na mokṣo me bhītasyaitā vibhīṣikāḥ | pratibimbam idam buddher jaleṣv iva vivasvataḥ

plain_english: Sense-doored, all — meeting pleasure, pain and such: senses thus having left, self-abiding — in one's own self one abides.
sanskrit_cite: indriyadvārakaṃ sarvaṃ sukhaduḥkhādisaṃgamam | itīndriyāṇi saṃtyajya svasthaḥ svātmani vartate

plain_english: Knowing-lighting all — by all self lighting: one, from one-natureness — knowing, knowable, is envisioned.
sanskrit_cite: jñānaprakāśakaṃ sarvaṃ sarveṇātmā prakāśakaḥ | ekam ekasvabhāvatvāt jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ vibhāvyate

plain_english: Mental, consciousness, power, self, and mind — the fourfold: when, O dear, fully wasted — then that Bhairava form.
sanskrit_cite: mānasaṃ cetanā śaktir ātmā ceti catuṣṭayam | yadā priye parikṣīṇaṃ tadā tad bhairavaṃ vapuḥ

plain_english: Of waveless teachings, a hundred told in brief; twelve-plus — O Goddess, which having known, the knowing-knower person.
sanskrit_cite: nistaraṅgopadeśānāṃ śatam uktaṃ samāsataḥ | dvādaśābhyadhikaṃ devi yaj jñātvā jñānavij janaḥ

plain_english: Here and in one, yoked — he becomes Bhairava himself: by speech does deeds — curse-and-favor making.
sanskrit_cite: atra caikatame yukto jāyate bhairavaḥ svayam | vācā karoti karmāṇi śāpānugrahakārakaḥ
